Heightfield terrain

4 calls on gfx, generated from the firmware. Every one exists on the device exactly as written here.

The Comanche-style voxel-ish renderer (engine v4-v6): Lua drives the camera, C marches the columns.

gfx.floor

gfx.floor(cfg) -> bool

engine v6

Mode-7 textured ground plane (engine v6): sweeps the loaded terrain colormap per scanline. cfg: x, y, z, yaw, horizon, vy, vh, focal, dist, fog1, fog2, tscale, sky, far. Fills the same depth buffer gfx.ssprite z-tests against. false = nothing loaded.

#argument
1cfgrequired
15 table fields, with defaults
xdefault 0.0
ydefault 0.0
zdefault 12.0
yawdefault 0.0
horizondefault 46.0
vydefault 0.0
vhdefault 200.0
focaldefault 110.0
distdefault 90.0
fog1default 35.0
fog2default 60.0
tscaledefault 2.0
skydefault 12.0
fardefault 12.0
depthdefault true

gfx.terrain

gfx.terrain(cfg) -> bool

engine v4

Render the loaded heightfield (engine v4). cfg: x, y, z, yaw (required-ish; default 0), horizon, vy, vh, focal, dist, fog1, fog2 (shademap levels 2/3 distance bands), water, wcolor, sky, colw. Fills the per-pixel depth buffer ssprite z-tests against. false = no terrain loaded (parallels gfx.image).

#argument
1cfgrequired
16 table fields, with defaults
xdefault 0.0
ydefault 0.0
zdefault 10.0
yawdefault 0.0
horizondefault 64.0
vydefault 0.0
vhdefault 168.0
focaldefault 92.0
distdefault 64.0
fog1default 22.0
fog2default 44.0
waterdefault -1.0
skydefault 12.0
wcolordefault 12.0
colwdefault 1.0
depthdefault true

gfx.theight

gfx.theight(x, y) -> number

Bilinear terrain height in world units (movement, camera, billboard feet). 0 when no terrain is loaded.

#argument
1xrequired
2yrequired

gfx.tload

gfx.tload(name [, hscale]) -> bool

needs asset files

Load assets/terrain/{name}_h.vsp + {name}_c.vsp (square power-of-two planes) into the terrain slot. hscale converts height bytes to world units (default 0.1). One slot per app run.

#argument
1namerequired: terrain name only (no path, no extension)
2hscaleoptional
